svg.title: Coupling graphs of the seven QPU twins
svg.desc: The coupling graphs the twins enforce, drawn from the packaged device data: complete graphs for the two trapped-ion processors, synthetic square lattices for Rigetti and IQM, and the vendors' own published maps for IBM Heron r3, IBM Nighthawk and Google Willow (inactive couplers dashed). The qubits and couplers of a 4-qubit GHZ chain are highlighted.
svg.text: natives: gpi · gpi2 · rz · ms · zz
